items.name: rectangular-grid
items.description: Children in rows and columns, with brick offsets and cells that fit, fix or fill.

items.name: radial-grid
items.description: Children round a circle or along an arc, turned to face out if you like.

items.name: path-grid
items.description: Children spaced along a template, a path of their own, or a Path node in the scene.

items.name: sphere-grid
items.description: Children spread evenly over a sphere, seen through a camera of its own.
